purpose: Anchors that cannot be fragmented for parity, with the reason and the disposition they require. Keeps the divergence machine-readable instead of only in commit messages. Every entry names what is missing and who must decide.

findings.reason: Cardinality cannot pair: the frozen maquette renders 4 hard-coded demo chips (Prism EQ / Guide OpenDesign / Unifia Vault / Reglages), while the app renders a variable number of real recent workspaces. The plan's authority order puts real behaviour above maquette demo data.

Key-set divergence (GAP-02): the reference rail carries 6 keyed data-mode buttons (code/work/design/automate/browser/memory) plus a settings button; the app registry SHELL_MODES carries 4 and filters Automate further by the workflow.run grant. Pairing requires identical key sets.
Zero reference counterpart: the frozen maquette contains no workspace-tabs markup at all. The bar is an app concept introduced by ADR-038, not a port target.
evidence: counterpart scan: 0 matches for workspace-tabs in the frozen maquette

findings.reason: No static reference selector: the maquette's diff/review UI is generated by JavaScript into the inspector (reviewCard/reviewHTML/versionDiff) rather than existing as stable markup, so the reference side cannot be addressed by a static selector.
findings.blocker: reference strategy (interaction-driven reference, or an approved static fixture)

findings.reason: Multi-count with no stable reference key: 7 .composer elements in the maquette, none carrying a business key. Pairing would fall back to document-order, which the plan forbids without an explicit order contract.
findings.blocker: pairing strategy: an explicit order contract or a reference key

findings.reason: Multi-count with no stable reference key: 25 .msg elements in the maquette, none carrying a business key. Same document-order prohibition as session.composer.
findings.blocker: pairing strategy: an explicit order contract or a reference key

notes: No entry here is a PASS. Each is an unfragmented anchor whose divergence is deliberately visible.
intentional-difference requires a null mask plus product approval per plan section 4.3; none of the three has that approval yet, so no fragment is written for them either.
blocked-external for code.diff means the reference cannot be addressed as-is; it is not a runtime capability gap like Browser/Automate.
Anchors that ARE fragmented: 16 (home x6, shell x3, code x2, work x2, memory x1, automate x1, settings x1).
